title.value: Hierarchical Reinforcement Learning for Precise Soccer Shooting Skills using a Quadrupedal Robot
title.justification: The paper is about developing hierarchical reinforcement learning methods to enable quadrupedal robots to perform precise soccer shooting skills.
title.quote: Hierarchical Reinforcement Learning for Precise Soccer Shooting Skills using a Quadrupedal Robot

extractions.description: This paper discusses the development and application of hierarchical reinforcement learning frameworks to enable a quadrupedal robot to execute precise soccer shooting skills. The approach decomposes the task into motion control and motion planning, training a policy to handle arbitrary shooting motions while maintaining balance, and a planning policy to achieve target shooting. The effectiveness of the framework is demonstrated through experiments, highlighting significant improvements after applying the method on real-world tasks. This research contributes to advancements in robot motion control and planning under uncertain dynamics like a deformable soccer ball with friction variability.
